stemBlocks: A triangular ramp with angles to the horizontal of $60^\circ$ and $30^\circ$ is placed with its largest face horizontal. A block of mass $1.5 \text{kg}$ and a block of mass $m$ are joined by a light, inextensible string and placed on the ramp as shown.

The string passes over a light, frictionless pulley.
The maximum force of friction between the block of mass $1.5 \text{kg}$ and the surface of the ramp is $3.5 \text{ N}$.
The maximum force of friction between the block of mass $m$ and the surface of the ramp is $5.0 \text{ N}$.
What is the maximum value of $m$ that allows the blocks to remain stationary on the surfaces?

assets.alt: A triangular ramp with two blocks connected by a string over a pulley. One block is labeled '1.5 kg' and the other 'm'. The ramp has angles of 60 degrees and 30 degrees to the horizontal.
